repos_data.description: Headless, deterministic audio engine for AI agents: compose scores as data, render byte-reproducible PCM offline, then listen through features, spectrograms, and assertions — no audio device, no human ear, no ffmpeg.
The agent eval standard for MCP — score output quality, catch safety failures, enforce cost budgets
Rules lawyer for agents. Deterministic rules verdicts for game-running agents: cited, reproducible, honest about jurisdiction. SRD 5.2.1 + 5.1 adapters.
Don't write a bug report — record it. Local MCP: screen recording → transcript, frames, OCR, wall-clock evidence for coding agents.
Broadcast audio playout for macOS — crossfade, trim, ramp timers, pause beds, play logging. An experiment built entirely with Claude Code by a non-Swift developer, presented as-is.

repo_meta_data.description: Loudness compliance verdicts against formal published standards (EBU R128, ATSC A/85) — pass/fail with exact deltas and remediation, not raw meter output. CLI + MCP over one ffmpeg-based engine.
